chunking.description: OpenVAS: marker captures the `Severity (CVSS: X.Y)` header line that sits immediately above each `NVT:` line. Previously we marked at `NVT:` itself, which left the severity/cvss header in the PREVIOUS chunk and forced the LLM to guess severity (often defaulting to LOG) — see misclassification on Ingreslock / Telnet in bBWA. By breaking ONE line earlier the header travels with its NVT.
